name: Shimoichi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shimoichi town emblem in maroon: a winged ring of concentric lines.
history: Municipal flag of Shimoichi, a town in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 12 March 1958.

features.role: Shimoichi town emblem — a winged ring of concentric lines
